A '''castle''' that once belonged to the [[Earl of Vis/Legends|Earl of Vis]] was located in the [[Western Reaches (Naboo)|Western Reaches]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Earl/Legends|Earl's]] descendent [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] took shelter in it in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].
